JetBrains Mono 2.304 (embedded subset)

Source: https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono/releases/tag/v2.304
Archive: JetBrainsMono-2.304.zip
  sha256 6f6376c6ed2960ea8a963cd7387ec9d76e3f629125bc33d1fdcd7eb7012f7bbf
Inputs (fonts/ttf inside the archive):
  JetBrainsMono-Medium.ttf   sha256 31c92d01a8a08528b718a43addf0ad3df0af2ca4b7b3290a452f70f358e14d3d
  JetBrainsMono-SemiBold.ttf sha256 1b3bfa1ed5665a4ce3f9feb68d2d4e40e70bf8b4b7d9a3edd418f321b4e166a0
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt in this folder, copied unchanged from the archive).
  No Reserved Font Name is declared in the copyright notice.

Subset (fontTools 4.63.0, default layout features incl. calt, all name records kept so the
copyright and license fields stay in the font):
  pyftsubset <in>.ttf --unicodes="U+0020-007E,U+00A0-00FF,U+0100-017F,U+0218-021B,U+02C6,U+02DA,
    U+02DC,U+2010-2015,U+2018-201E,U+2022,U+2026,U+2030,U+2032,U+2033,U+2039,U+203A,U+20AC,U+2116,
    U+2122,U+2190-2195,U+2212,U+2264,U+2265,U+2713,U+25B4,U+25BE,U+25B2,U+25BC,U+00B0"
    --name-IDs='*' --name-legacy --name-languages='*' --notdef-outline --output-file=<out>

Use: compiled into EcuFps.exe as byte arrays (cmake/embed.cmake) and loaded by DirectWrite as an
in-memory font collection (ui/render/graphics.cpp). No font file is written to disk or shipped loose.
Purpose: technical index / numeric labels on the Panel ("01 //", "TEPE %58", "1080p", ...), as in
the owner-approved BOOST mockup. If loading fails the app falls back to Cascadia Mono / Consolas.
